title: Just Like Us
about: Episode 6, the user's idea: a kind man seen all through, until at the very end he peels back his face and the series' robot is underneath, eye still blue (not a villain). The question it leaves: would you have known, and does it matter if he was only ever kind? Silent film for the user's own music; only the last line is written. Revised after the user's notes: the rain scene glitches as the rain hits him (the first take glitched by accident and the user liked it), the boy scene is replaced, and the face reveal is a glitch between two matching mirror shots instead of a peel, which Wan could only do plastically.

cast.man: a friendly handsome man in his thirties with short brown hair and a warm perfect smile, wearing a grey cardigan
